index.title: Knowledge
index.lead: A knowledge base is a set of documents AnyLearn is allowed to answer from. Nothing outside one is ever consulted.
index.empty: You have no knowledge bases yet. Make one, then add the documents you want to be able to ask about.

up.title: Make a knowledge base, then add what you study
up.description: Everything AnyLearn answers from lives in one. Add files, links, sites or highlights to it.

detail.empty: No documents yet. Add one to make this knowledge base answerable.
detail.deleteConfirm: Delete this knowledge base and everything in it? This cannot be undone.
detail.reindexHint: Re-embeds every passage with your current embedding model. The text and page numbers stay as they are.
detail.needsReembedTitle: This knowledge base must be reindexed
detail.needsReembedBody: Your embedding model changed since these documents were indexed. Queries are blocked until the passages are re-embedded, because ranking new questions against old vectors returns confident, wrong answers rather than an error.
detail.lede: The documents AnyLearn may answer from here, how far each one has been read, and the ways to study from them.
detail.dangerNote: Deleting removes every document, passage, book and audio overview in this knowledge base.

upload.label: Add a document
upload.drop: Drop a file here, or choose one
upload.accepted: PDF, DOCX, PPTX, EPUB, HTML, Markdown, plain text, or a spreadsheet (XLSX, CSV, TSV). Up to 50 MB, up to 400 pages.

table.name: Document
table.removeConfirm: Remove this document and its passages?

status.live: This list refreshes while documents are being processed.

debug.title: Test retrieval
debug.hint: Ask something this knowledge base should be able to answer. This runs the same hybrid search a chat answer would, and shows the passages it found.
debug.placeholder: What does this material say about…
debug.noResults: No passage matched. Either the documents do not cover it, or nothing has finished indexing yet.

viewer.notReady: This document has not finished processing yet.

errors.createFailed: The knowledge base could not be created.
errors.uploadFailed: The file could not be added.
errors.queryFailed: The search could not be run.
errors.reindexFailed: The reindex could not be started. Your embedding provider may be rate-limiting; try again in a minute.
errors.retryFailed: Could not queue the document again.
errors.deleteFailed: That document could not be removed.
errors.deleteKbFailed: The knowledge base could not be deleted.
errors.notFound: That knowledge base does not exist, or is not yours.
errors.linkFailed: The link could not be added.
errors.syncFailed: The page could not be re-synced.

drive.label: Google Drive
drive.connectBody: Connect Google Drive to add documents straight from it. AnyLearn asks only for the files you pick; it cannot see anything else in your Drive.
drive.needsReconnect: Google stopped accepting this Drive connection, so nothing here is syncing. Reconnect to continue.
drive.pickerTitle: Choose files or a folder to add
drive.syncBaselined: Sync started. Changes made in Drive from now on will be picked up.
drive.pickMoreHint: Picked files, and a picked folder's contents as of the moment you picked it, stay in sync: an edit in Drive re-indexes only that document. Files added to the folder later are not picked up on their own. Use Pick more to add them.
drive.unavailable: Google Drive could not be loaded right now. Your documents are unaffected.

notice.denied: Google Drive was not connected: the Drive permission was not granted.
notice.failed: Google Drive could not be connected. Try again.
notice.no_refresh: Google did not return a lasting permission. Try connecting again and approve the consent screen.

errors.reconnect: Google stopped accepting this Drive connection. Reconnect Google Drive, then try again.
errors.notConnected: Google Drive is not connected. Connect it first.
errors.pickerFailed: The Google Drive picker could not be opened. Check that nothing is blocking apis.google.com, then try again.
errors.badSelection: That selection could not be read. Pick the files again.
errors.importFailed: The files could not be added from Drive.
errors.syncFailed: The sync could not be run.

related.title: Related papers
related.lead: Recent research related to these documents, found through OpenAlex from a summary of what is here. Nothing is added until you choose.
related.none: No recent papers matched. Try a focus.
related.addedPDF: Added: the open-access PDF is being read.
related.addedNote: Added as a note with the abstract and a link.

link.label: Add a link
link.hint: A web page (HTML or PDF, up to 5 MB) or a public YouTube video. A page is read once; turn on daily sync to keep it current.
link.autoSync: Check this page daily and re-index it when it changes
link.needsTranscript: Added “{{title}}”. It needs a transcript before it can be searched. Open it to add one.

sync.weekly: This page changes on every check, so it is now checked weekly.

video.aiTranscriptNote: AI transcript, made by your Gemini key from the video's sound. Words may be misheard and times are approximate. You can replace it with a subtitle file at any time.
video.noTimes: This transcript has no timestamps, so its lines cannot move the video.

needs.title: This video needs a transcript
needs.why: AnyLearn studies a video through its words.
needs.geminiBody: Google fetches the public video, and your own Gemini key writes the transcript. The video is never downloaded to AnyLearn.
needs.estimate: About {{tokens}} tokens: {{minutes}} min at 100 tokens a second.
needs.estimateUnknown: The length could not be read here. At 100 tokens a second, 10 minutes is about 60,000 tokens.
needs.freeTier: The free tier transcribes up to {{hours}} hours of YouTube video a day.
needs.publicOnly: Only public videos can be transcribed, not private or unlisted ones.
needs.label: Labelled “AI transcript” wherever it is shown: it may mishear words, and its times are approximate.
needs.noKey: To have Gemini transcribe public videos, add a Gemini API key to your Parse route in Settings.
needs.pasteHint: With a time like [12:34] at the start of each line, or plain text without times.
needs.working: Making the transcript. This page updates when it is ready.

source.creator: Transcript: the creator's captions.
source.auto: Transcript: YouTube's auto-generated captions, which can mishear words.

notes.title: Study notes
notes.lead: Study notes split this video into sections, each with a short summary and the key points. Click any time to watch that moment.
notes.cost: One call to your reading model, written from the transcript; the video is not downloaded.
notes.writing: Writing study notes… a long video can take a minute.
notes.failed: The notes could not be written.
notes.another: The same notes in another language:
notes.byChapters: Written by {{model}} from the transcript, one section per chapter of the creator's. A model can be wrong: check a point against the video.
notes.byModel: Written by {{model}} from the transcript. A model can be wrong: check a point against the video.
notes.stale: The transcript changed after these notes were written, so some times may be off. Write them again to match it.

engines.title: Transcribe
engines.lead: Choose who transcribes this video. Each way says what it costs; nothing runs until you press Transcribe.
engines.builtinBody: {{model}} on this server, with no key. The server fetches the video's audio, transcribes it, and deletes the audio when it is done.
engines.builtinMinutes: {{used}} of your {{daily}} built-in minutes used today. This video needs {{need}}.
engines.builtinLine: Transcriptions waiting for the built-in engine now: {{count}}. One runs at a time.
engines.audioBody: The server fetches the video's audio and sends it to {{provider}} with your key ({{model}}). About {{minutes}} min of audio is billed to your account.
engines.blockedBefore: YouTube refused this server the audio last time, so it may refuse again. Your Gemini key reads the video without a download.
engines.label: Labelled “AI transcript” wherever it is shown, with who transcribed it: words may be misheard, and times are approximate.
engines.chooseFirst: Choose one of the ways above first.
engines.none: Nothing can transcribe this video yet. Add a Groq, OpenAI or Gemini key under Settings → Connections and route Speech to text to it, or upload subtitles below.
engines.queueAhead: Transcriptions ahead of this one on the built-in engine: {{count}}.
engines.transcriptBuiltin: AI transcript, transcribed by {{model}} on this server from the video's sound. Words may be misheard and times are approximate. You can replace it with a subtitle file at any time.
engines.transcriptKey: AI transcript, transcribed by your {{provider}} key ({{model}}) from the video's sound. Words may be misheard and times are approximate. You can replace it with a subtitle file at any time.

site.label: Add a site
site.hint: AnyLearn follows links on the same site that sit under the start page's folder, up to {{maxDepth}} links deep and {{maxPages}} pages, and skips what the site's robots.txt asks tools to leave alone. Each page becomes its own document. The site is checked again weekly; only changed pages are re-indexed.
site.added: Started reading “{{title}}”. Its progress is shown under Sites and repositories.

repo.label: Add a repository
repo.pathPlaceholder: The whole repository, or e.g. docs
repo.ignore: Paths to skip, one per line (.gitignore style)
repo.hint: The repository is downloaded once per commit. Dependency folders, build output, lockfiles and media are skipped. At most {{files}} files, {{fileMB}} MB a file and {{repoMB}} MB in all, because each file is embedded with your own key. A private repository needs your GitHub token in Settings → Search keys.
repo.added: Started importing {{title}}. Its progress is shown under Sites and repositories.

sources.label: Sites and repositories
sources.unavailable: Sites and repositories could not be loaded right now.
sources.deleteSiteConfirm: Delete this site and every page it added to this knowledge base?
sources.deleteRepoConfirm: Delete this repository and every file it added to this knowledge base?

errors.siteFailed: The site could not be added.
errors.repoFailed: The repository could not be added.
errors.actionFailed: That did not work. Try again.

media.accepted: Audio and video too: MP3, WAV, M4A, OGG, Opus, WebM, MP4, MPEG or MOV, up to 500 MB. A recording is transcribed only when you choose how.
media.tooLarge: {{name}} is larger than {{mb}} MB, so it was not sent.
media.needsWhy: AnyLearn studies a recording through its words.
media.none: Nothing can transcribe this recording yet. Add a Groq, OpenAI or Gemini key under Settings → Connections and route Speech to text to it, or upload subtitles below.
media.builtinBody: {{model}} on this server, with no key. The server reads your uploaded file; nothing is sent elsewhere.
media.audioBody: The server sends the file's audio to {{provider}} with your key ({{model}}). About {{minutes}} min of audio is billed to your account.
media.geminiBody: The file is uploaded to Gemini under your own key, transcribed, and deleted from Gemini when the transcript is done.
media.geminiEstimate: About {{tokens}} tokens: {{minutes}} min at {{rate}} tokens a second.
media.geminiEstimateUnknown: Unknown length, so the cost cannot be worked out first. Gemini counts {{audio}} tokens a second of audio and about {{video}} a second of video.
media.unknownLength: This file's length could not be read, so what it costs is not known in advance. I understand, transcribe it anyway.
media.cancelHint: Stops after the part being transcribed now. Parts not reached are not billed.
media.cancelFailed: The transcription could not be cancelled.
media.transcriptGemini: AI transcript, made by your Gemini key from the recording. Words may be misheard and times are approximate. You can replace it with a subtitle file at any time.
media.transcriptBuiltin: AI transcript, transcribed by {{model}} on this server from the recording. Words may be misheard and times are approximate. You can replace it with a subtitle file at any time.
media.transcriptKey: AI transcript, transcribed by your {{provider}} key ({{model}}) from the recording. Words may be misheard and times are approximate. You can replace it with a subtitle file at any time.
media.oneAtATime: {{name}} is audio or video: add it on its own, not with other files.

photos.accepted: Or photos of pages and notes (PNG, JPEG, WebP, HEIC), up to 20 MB each. Large photos are scaled to 3000 px in your browser first, and photos from a camera lose their location data.
photos.togetherHint: One page per photo, in this order, up to 30 photos. Otherwise each photo is its own document.
photos.tooMany: One document holds at most 30 photos.
photos.cannotShow: This browser cannot show this photo (Safari shows HEIC). The text read from it is beside it.
photos.viewerHint: Each photo is shown beside the text read from it, so you can check the reading against the page.

zotero.label: Add from Zotero
zotero.lead: Search your own Zotero library, or browse its collections, and add one item at a time. An item whose PDF is in your Zotero storage comes in as that PDF; any other comes in as a note of its details and abstract, with a link.
zotero.notConnected: Add your Zotero user ID and key first.
zotero.emptyCollection: This collection has no items of its own.
zotero.addedPDF: Added: the PDF from your Zotero storage is being read.
zotero.addedNote: Added as a note with the details, the abstract and a link.

feed.label: Feeds
feed.linkHint: It can also be a podcast’s RSS feed, or a YouTube playlist, channel or @handle. AnyLearn then lists its episodes or videos, and you pick which to add.
feed.empty: No feeds yet. Paste a podcast’s RSS link, or a YouTube playlist or channel link, into “Add a link”.
feed.unavailable: Feeds could not be loaded right now.
feed.keylessLimit: YouTube’s free feed lists only the latest {{limit}} videos.
feed.dataApiHint: With your own YouTube Data API key (Settings, Search keys) a playlist lists all its videos, up to {{limit}}.
feed.dataApiListed: Listed through your YouTube Data API key: every video, up to {{limit}}.
feed.daily: AnyLearn checks this feed once a day and marks what it finds as New.
feed.autoAdd: Add new entries by themselves, at most {{count}} a day
feed.autoAddHint: They become documents waiting for a transcript; nothing is transcribed until you choose an engine.
feed.pickHint: Tick what to add. An episode is downloaded once and kept here; each one then waits for a transcript, and its page shows each engine’s cost or time before you start.
feed.deleteConfirm: Stop following this feed? The documents it added stay in the knowledge base.

errors.checkFailed: The feed could not be checked.
errors.addFailed: Those entries could not be added.
errors.updateFailed: The feed could not be updated.
errors.deleteFailed: The feed could not be removed.

study.label: Study from this knowledge base
study.waiting: Asking, questions, a path and a book open here once one document is ready.
study.chatNote: a conversation that answers only from these documents, with sources.
study.quizNote: questions drawn from these documents, for spaced review.
study.pathNote: modules with a check at the end of each.
study.bookNote: chapters written from these documents, further down this page.

share.title: Add to AnyLearn
share.lead: Add what you shared to a knowledge base, as Add a link does: a page, a video, a playlist or a podcast feed.
share.noLink: This share has no web link. AnyLearn adds links; files can be uploaded in Knowledge.
share.newKb: A name for your first knowledge base
share.failed: The link could not be added. Try again.

highlights.lead: Add your Kindle or KOReader highlights: each book becomes a document here, with its highlights and notes, to read, ask about, quiz and save words from. On a Kindle the file is documents/My Clippings.txt; KOReader exports JSON.
highlights.pick: Choose My Clippings.txt or a KOReader export
highlights.none: No highlights were found in this file.
highlights.added_one: {{count}} book added. It appears in the list below while it is being read.
highlights.added_other: {{count}} books added. They appear in the list below while they are being read.
